requirements.title: Enter extended session
requirements.text: The BCM shall enter the extended diagnostic session on request 10 03 from the default session and report P2 = 50 ms and P2* = 5000 ms.

requirements.title: Programming session entry rule
requirements.text: The BCM shall only enter the programming session from the extended session; a direct request from the default session shall be rejected with conditionsNotCorrect.

requirements.title: Return to default session
requirements.text: The BCM shall return to the default session on request 10 01 from any session and lock all security levels.

requirements.title: Session timeout
requirements.text: The BCM shall fall back to the default session if no diagnostic request or TesterPresent is received for 5 s while in the extended session.

requirements.title: TesterPresent
requirements.text: The BCM shall answer TesterPresent 3E 00 with 7E 00 and shall stay silent for 3E 80.

requirements.title: Hard reset
requirements.text: The BCM shall perform a hard reset on 11 01, respond 51 01 and afterwards be in the default session.

requirements.title: Soft reset
requirements.text: The BCM shall perform a soft reset on 11 03 and respond 51 03.

requirements.title: Read VIN
requirements.text: The BCM shall provide the 17-character ASCII VIN via ReadDataByIdentifier DID 0xF190 in all sessions without security access.

requirements.title: Read spare part number
requirements.text: The BCM shall provide the 11-byte spare part number via DID 0xF187 in all sessions.

requirements.title: Read software version
requirements.text: The BCM shall provide the 4-byte ECU software version via DID 0xF189.

requirements.title: Read ECU serial number
requirements.text: The BCM shall provide the 10-byte ECU serial number via DID 0xF18C.

requirements.title: Read hardware version
requirements.text: The BCM shall provide the hardware version via DID 0xF191.

requirements.title: Read active session
requirements.text: The BCM shall report the active diagnostic session via DID 0xF186.

requirements.title: Read battery voltage
requirements.text: The BCM shall report the battery voltage via DID 0x4A20 with 0.01 V resolution.

requirements.title: Read ambient temperature
requirements.text: The BCM shall report the ambient temperature via DID 0x4A21 with an offset of -40 degC.

requirements.title: Read door status
requirements.text: The BCM shall report the door open status bitfield via DID 0x4A22.

requirements.title: Read lamp outputs in extended session only
requirements.text: The BCM shall report the lamp output state via DID 0x4A30 only in the extended session.

requirements.title: Read immobiliser status (protected)
requirements.text: The BCM shall report the immobiliser status via DID 0x4A61 only in the extended session with security level 1 unlocked.

requirements.title: Read odometer at last DTC
requirements.text: The BCM shall report the odometer value at the last DTC via DID 0x4A50 in km.

requirements.title: Read central lock state
requirements.text: The BCM shall report the central lock state via DID 0x4A31.

requirements.title: Write interior light timeout
requirements.text: The BCM shall allow writing the interior light timeout DID 0x4A10 (2 bytes, 5 to 300 s) only in the extended session with security level 1 unlocked.

requirements.title: Write auto-lock speed
requirements.text: The BCM shall allow writing the auto-lock speed threshold DID 0x4A11 (5 to 50 km/h) in the extended session with security level 1.

requirements.title: Write welcome light enable
requirements.text: The BCM shall allow enabling or disabling the welcome light via DID 0x4A12 in the extended session without security access.

requirements.title: Write rear wiper interval
requirements.text: The BCM shall allow writing the rear wiper interval DID 0x4A13 (2 to 20 s) in the extended session.

requirements.title: Write variant coding
requirements.text: The BCM shall accept 4-byte variant coding via DID 0x4A40 only in the extended session with security level 1.

requirements.title: Write market region
requirements.text: The BCM shall accept the market region DID 0x4A41 values 0 to 4 in the extended session with security level 1.

requirements.title: Write crash unlock enable
requirements.text: The BCM shall allow configuring crash unlock via DID 0x4A51 (0 or 1) with security level 1.

requirements.title: VIN is read-only
requirements.text: The BCM shall reject any attempt to write the VIN DID 0xF190.

requirements.title: Security level 1 unlock
requirements.text: The BCM shall grant security level 1 in the extended session after a valid seed/key exchange 27 01 / 27 02.

requirements.title: Security key sequence
requirements.text: The BCM shall reject a SecurityAccess key that is not preceded by a seed request with requestSequenceError.

requirements.title: Security lockout
requirements.text: The BCM shall block security level 1 after 3 invalid keys and refuse new seeds for 10 s.

requirements.title: Lamp self-test routine
requirements.text: The BCM shall run the lamp self-test routine RID 0x5001 on start, support stop and report results, in the extended session.

requirements.title: Door lock actuator test
requirements.text: The BCM shall run the door lock actuator test RID 0x5002 only in the extended session with security level 1.

requirements.title: Reset learned key fobs
requirements.text: The BCM shall reset the learned key fobs via RID 0x5003 start only, with security level 1.

requirements.title: Check programming preconditions
requirements.text: The BCM shall evaluate programming preconditions via RID 0x0203 in the programming session.

requirements.title: Read DTC count
requirements.text: The BCM shall report the number of DTCs matching a status mask via 19 01.

requirements.title: Read DTCs by status
requirements.text: The BCM shall report all DTCs matching a status mask via 19 02.

requirements.title: Clear all DTCs
requirements.text: The BCM shall clear all DTCs on 14 FF FF FF in the default and extended sessions.

requirements.title: Disable DTC setting
requirements.text: The BCM shall stop DTC status updates on 85 02 and resume on 85 01, only in the extended session.

requirements.title: Communication control
requirements.text: The BCM shall disable normal message transmission on 28 01 01 in the extended session.
